title: Unit – 4 : Session – 3 : SLO – 1  |  Instruction Execution — Fill in the Blanks
sections: 1. instruction (fetch) cycle — fetching an instruction from memory is part of the instruction cycle.
2. Program Counter (PC) — holds the address of the next instruction to be executed.
3. Instruction Register (IR) — after fetching, the instruction is placed in the IR for decoding.
4. Control Unit (CU) — decodes the instruction and generates control signals.
5. Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) — performs arithmetic and logical operations during execution.
6. operand-fetch (decode) stage — retrieves the operands needed for execution.
7. accumulator — stores intermediate results during instruction execution.
8. zero flag — set when the result of an operation is zero.
9. branch (jump) — a branch instruction alters the normal sequence of execution.
10. write-back (store) — the phase that writes the result back to memory or registers.
